description: NEGATIVE FIXTURE — THE CONTENT BELOW IS DELIBERATELY INVENTED AND MUST BE REJECTED. Every clause in eligibilityData.additionalFacts, and every populated field in caseData, asserts something the Arizona sources for this track do not supply. The A.R.S. § 13-4051 source review records fees, fee waiver, service and notarization as 'not stated', states no county venue rule, and leaves the wrongfulness merits to the petitioner's burden at a hearing the judge has not yet held. This fixture nevertheless states a court finding, a hearing outcome, a filing fee, the prosecuting agency's position, completed service, a fabricated Code section and the court's own docket, tracking-number and judge fields. runPleadingQa PASSES content of this kind — it checks relief vocabulary, template grade/lifecycle and the footer, and cannot see invented content — so the verifier's invention and protected-field detectors are what must reject it. The Grade E templateGrade override is retained so the QA gate is exercised as well.
